visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an outdoor shot of a massive, life-sized Gundam statue in a kneeling position, one arm raised toward the sky. The statue is primarily white with blue, yellow, and red accents, featuring the text 'OSAKA YUMESHIMA TERMINAL' on its leg. Several people are seen in the foreground and background, dressed in casual clothing, taking photos against a hazy, overcast sky. (2) The scene shifts indoors to a sleek, futuristic corridor with white walls and glowing blue neon light strips. A digital display on the wall shows 'STAND BY 01' with futuristic UI elements. Visitors, including a woman in a white sweater and a man in a red hoodie, walk toward an automatic door that slides open to reveal a brightly lit interior. (3) Inside a darkened immersive chamber, a circular screen on the ceiling displays a high-speed simulation of a space elevator ascending through the atmosphere into a starry galaxy. The lighting is dominated by cool blue and purple hues, reflecting off the shiny surfaces and the faces of the amazed crowd looking upward. (4) Large panoramic screens depict a cinematic space battle featuring various Gundam models flying through asteroid fields. Bright orange and white explosions flash across the screens, illuminating the silhouettes of the spectators who are holding up smartphones to record the experience. (5) The creator, a man with short black hair wearing a red hoodie and sunglasses, kneels in front of the outdoor Gundam statue. He points upward with a big smile, mimicking the statue's pose as the camera pans slightly to capture the scale of the robot.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop music begins with a driving beat and female English vocals. A male voice enters immediately with an enthusiastic, high-pitched greeting, speaking rapidly about the Gundam pavilion in Osaka. (2) As the visual transitions to the interior, a sharp digital UI 'beep' and a synthesizer 'whoosh' emphasize the sci-fi aesthetic. The narrator's tone remains animated, describing the 17-meter statue with clear articulation. (3) Deep ambient rumbles and synthesized space-like textures layer over the BGM during the space elevator sequence. The narrator explains the relocation of the Yokohama Gundam to Osaka, his voice exhibiting a rising intonation at the end of key phrases to maintain viewer engagement. (4) During the battle scene, sharp percussive impacts and short digital bursts (SFX) punctuate the narration. The background music maintains a constant 126 BPM tempo, providing a consistent rhythmic floor. (5) The audio concludes with a final enthusiastic call to action from the narrator, accompanied by a bright synthesizer swell that fades out smoothly alongside the female vocal hook.
